content: DcmDspEcuResetRow container configuration One container DcmDspEcuResetRow shall be configured for each DcmDsdSubSer- vice ( DcmDspEcuResetId matching to the DcmDsdSubServiceId ) configured for the UDS service ECUReset (0x11) which does not have the corresponding DcmDsd- SubServiceFnc parameter configured.
